title: Anatomical annotation audit: case-83
hypothesis: A single patient can expose a localized anatomical annotation reasoning gap without the cost of reviewing the full eight-patient batch.
why_hard: Reviewed Terra/max and Sol/xhigh misses on identical task bytes: both omitted the planted kidney-pole defect from their final reports. Sol used 16.61 agent minutes, 30,292 output tokens and estimated USD 3.092, despite receiving multi-plane images.
next_action: Retain as a cross-model failure-backed alternate; prioritize case 32 for the lower observed Sol time, output and estimated cost. Any viewer contrast must be separately frozen.

sources.note: User requests one trial per task and resource benchmarking.
